title: Accumulator
sources: Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: Buys one share a week at a discount to the initial level, twice as many when the stock is below that price, until it closes at or above the knock-out level.

params.name: strike
params.label: Purchase price, % of the initial level

params.name: knock_out
params.label: Knock-out level, % of the initial level

params.name: gearing
params.label: Shares bought below the strike, per share above

script:
# Weekly for six months. Each purchase is marked at the close: its value is
# (spot - strike) per share, paid on the purchase date. The knock-out is
# checked first: no purchase on the day it knocks out.

2027-01-04
    strike = 0.9
    knock_out = 1.05
    gearing = 2
    s0 = spot()
    k = strike * s0
    alive = 1

schedule(2027-01-11, 2027-06-28, 1W, US, F)
    if spot() >= knock_out * s0 then alive = 0 endIf
    if alive = 1 then
        if spot() >= k then pays spot() - k else pays gearing * (spot() - k) endIf
    endIf

2027-07-06
    if spot() >= knock_out * s0 then alive = 0 endIf
    if alive = 1 then
        if spot() >= k then pays spot() - k else pays gearing * (spot() - k) endIf
    endIf

title: Altiplano
sources: Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: A capital-protected note paying a large coupon if none of three stocks ever closes a month below the barrier; otherwise a basket call instead.

params.name: barrier
params.label: Barrier on each stock, % of its initial level

script:
# Monthly monitoring of each stock against its own strike-date level.

2027-01-04
    notional = 1000
    coupon = 0.2
    barrier = 0.8
    s0 = spot(0)
    s1 = spot(1)
    s2 = spot(2)
    breached = 0

schedule(2027-02-04, 2027-12-04, 1M, US, F)
    if spot(0) < barrier * s0 or spot(1) < barrier * s1 or spot(2) < barrier * s2 then breached = 1 endIf

2028-01-04
    if spot(0) < barrier * s0 or spot(1) < barrier * s1 or spot(2) < barrier * s2 then breached = 1 endIf
    basket = (spot(0) / s0 + spot(1) / s1 + spot(2) / s2) / 3
    if breached = 0 then
        pays notional * (1 + coupon)
    else
        pays notional * (1 + max(basket - 1, 0))
    endIf

title: Arithmetic Asian call
sources: Kemna & Vorst, A Pricing Method for Options Based on Average Asset Values, Journal of Banking & Finance, 1990
Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: A call on the average of twelve monthly closes instead of the final price: cheaper than a vanilla, and hard to manipulate at expiry.
script:
# Twelve monthly fixings, the last one on the maturity date.

2027-01-04
    strike = 1.0
    s0 = spot()
    acc = 0
    n = 0

schedule(2027-02-04, 2027-12-04, 1M, US, F)
    acc = acc + spot()
    n = n + 1

2028-01-04
    acc = acc + spot()
    n = n + 1
    pays max(acc / n - strike * s0, 0)

title: Averaging-in call
sources: Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: A call whose strike is the average of the first three monthly closes, so a bad entry day does not set the strike.

params.name: strike
params.label: Strike, % of the average of the first three fixings

script:
2027-01-04
    strike = 1.0
    acc = spot()

2027-02-04  2027-03-04
    acc = acc + spot()

2028-01-04
    pays max(spot() - strike * acc / 3, 0)

title: Athena (express) autocall
sources: Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: Redeemed at the first anniversary the stock is at or above the autocall level, with a coupon per year elapsed; capital at risk below the protection barrier after three years.

params.name: autocall
params.label: Autocall level, % of the initial level

params.name: protection
params.label: Protection barrier at maturity, % of the initial level

script:
# Snowball coupon: the coupon times the number of years at redemption.

2027-01-04
    notional = 1000
    coupon = 0.08
    autocall = 1.0
    protection = 0.6
    s0 = spot()
    alive = 1

2028-01-04
    if spot() >= autocall * s0 then
        pays notional * (1 + coupon)
        alive = 0
    endIf

2029-01-04
    if alive = 1 and spot() >= autocall * s0 then
        pays notional * (1 + 2 * coupon)
        alive = 0
    endIf

2030-01-04
    if alive = 1 then
        if spot() >= autocall * s0 then
            pays notional * (1 + 3 * coupon)
        else
            if spot() < protection * s0 then pays notional * spot() / s0 else pays notional endIf
        endIf
    endIf

title: Atlas
sources: Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: A call on a four-stock basket from which the best and the worst performers are removed at maturity.
script:
# The basket is the average of the two middle performers.

2027-01-04
    notional = 1000
    strike = 1.0
    s0 = spot(0)
    s1 = spot(1)
    s2 = spot(2)
    s3 = spot(3)

2028-01-04
    p0 = spot(0) / s0
    p1 = spot(1) / s1
    p2 = spot(2) / s2
    p3 = spot(3) / s3
    best = max(max(p0, p1), max(p2, p3))
    worst = min(min(p0, p1), min(p2, p3))
    middle = (p0 + p1 + p2 + p3 - best - worst) / 2
    pays notional * max(middle - strike, 0)

title: Barrier reverse convertible
sources: Rubinstein & Reiner, Breaking Down the Barriers, Risk, 1991
Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: Quarterly coupons; the capital is at risk only if the stock ever closes at or below the barrier and ends below its initial level.

params.name: barrier
params.label: Knock-in barrier, % of the initial level

script:
# Coupons are paid whatever happens; daily closes for the barrier.

2027-01-04
    notional = 1000
    coupon = 0.025
    barrier = 0.6
    s0 = spot()
    ki = 0

schedule(2027-01-05, 2027-12-30, 1D, US, F)
    if spot() <= barrier * s0 then ki = 1 endIf

2027-04-05  2027-07-06  2027-10-04
    pays notional * coupon

2028-01-04
    if spot() <= barrier * s0 then ki = 1 endIf
    pays notional * coupon
    if ki = 1 and spot() < s0 then pays notional * spot() / s0 else pays notional endIf

title: Basket call
sources: Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: A call on the equally weighted average performance of three stocks: diversification makes it cheaper than three calls.
script:
# Performance of each stock = final / strike-date level.

2027-01-04
    notional = 1000
    strike = 1.0
    s0 = spot(0)
    s1 = spot(1)
    s2 = spot(2)

2028-01-04
    basket = (spot(0) / s0 + spot(1) / s1 + spot(2) / s2) / 3
    pays notional * max(basket - strike, 0)

title: Best-of call
sources: Stulz, Options on the Minimum or the Maximum of Two Risky Assets, Journal of Financial Economics, 1982
Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: A call on the best performer of three stocks: expensive, and worth more the less the stocks move together.
script:
2027-01-04
    notional = 1000
    strike = 1.0
    s0 = spot(0)
    s1 = spot(1)
    s2 = spot(2)

2028-01-04
    best = max(spot(0) / s0, max(spot(1) / s1, spot(2) / s2))
    pays notional * max(best - strike, 0)

title: Bonus certificate
sources: Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: Tracks the stock, but pays at least the bonus level if it never closes at or below the barrier.

params.name: bonus
params.label: Bonus level, % of the initial level

script:
# Once the barrier is touched the certificate is plain stock.

2027-01-04
    notional = 1000
    bonus = 1.2
    barrier = 0.7
    s0 = spot()
    hit = 0

schedule(2027-01-05, 2027-12-30, 1D, US, F)
    if spot() <= barrier * s0 then hit = 1 endIf

2028-01-04
    if spot() <= barrier * s0 then hit = 1 endIf
    if hit = 0 then
        pays notional * max(spot() / s0, bonus)
    else
        pays notional * spot() / s0
    endIf

title: Call spread (capped call)
sources: Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: A call whose gain is capped: long a call at the strike, short a call at the cap.
script:
2027-01-04
    strike = 1.0
    cap = 1.2
    s0 = spot()

2028-01-04
    pays min(max(spot() - strike * s0, 0), (cap - strike) * s0)

title: Capital-protected note
sources: Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: The capital back for sure, plus a share of the stock's rise up to a cap: a zero-coupon bond and a call spread.
script:
# Two years, 100% capital protection.

2027-01-04
    notional = 1000
    participation = 0.8
    cap = 0.4
    s0 = spot()

2029-01-04
    pays notional * (1 + participation * min(max(spot() / s0 - 1, 0), cap))

title: Locally capped cliquet
sources: Wilmott, Cliquet Options and Volatility Models, Wilmott Magazine, 2002
Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: Adds up four quarterly returns, each floored and capped: a guaranteed-positive, capped exposure to steady growth.
script:
# Each quarter's return is measured from the previous quarter's close.

2027-01-04
    notional = 1000
    local_floor = 0.0
    local_cap = 0.03
    ref = spot()
    total = 0

2027-04-05  2027-07-06  2027-10-04
    total = total + min(max(spot() / ref - 1, local_floor), local_cap)
    ref = spot()

2028-01-04
    total = total + min(max(spot() / ref - 1, local_floor), local_cap)
    pays notional * total

title: Corridor variance swap
sources: Demeterfi, Derman, Kamal & Zou, A Guide to Volatility and Variance Swaps, Journal of Derivatives, 1999
Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: A variance swap that only counts the days the stock starts inside a corridor: cheaper downside or upside variance.

params.name: low
params.label: Corridor low, % of the initial level

params.name: high
params.label: Corridor high, % of the initial level

script:
# A return enters the sum only if the previous close was inside the
# corridor; the annualisation still divides by every day observed.

2027-01-04
    variance_notional = 10000
    vol_strike = 0.2
    low = 0.8
    high = 1.2
    s0 = spot()
    prev = spot()
    sumsq = 0
    n = 0

schedule(2027-01-05, 2027-12-30, 1D, US, F)
    if prev >= low * s0 and prev <= high * s0 then sumsq = sumsq + log(spot() / prev) ^ 2 endIf
    n = n + 1
    prev = spot()

2028-01-04
    if prev >= low * s0 and prev <= high * s0 then sumsq = sumsq + log(spot() / prev) ^ 2 endIf
    n = n + 1
    pays variance_notional * (252 * sumsq / n - vol_strike ^ 2)

title: Digital call (cash-or-nothing)
sources: Reiner & Rubinstein, Unscrambling the Binary Code, Risk, 1991
Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: Pays a fixed amount if the stock ends above the strike, nothing otherwise.

params.name: payout
params.label: Cash paid if above the strike

script:
# A hard threshold makes the Monte-Carlo delta noisy: tick Fuzzy to smooth it.

2027-01-04
    strike = 1.0
    payout = 100
    s0 = spot()

2028-01-04
    if spot() > strike * s0 then pays payout endIf

title: Discount certificate
sources: Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: The stock bought at a discount, with the upside capped: long the stock, short a call.

params.name: notional
params.label: Notional of stock at the initial level

script:
# The discount is the price of the call sold, visible in the present value.

2027-01-04
    notional = 1000
    cap = 1.05
    s0 = spot()

2028-01-04
    pays notional * min(spot() / s0, cap)

title: Double no-touch
sources: Reiner & Rubinstein, Unscrambling the Binary Code, Risk, 1991
Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: Pays a fixed amount if the stock stays strictly inside a range at every close: a bet on low volatility.

params.name: low
params.label: Lower barrier, % of the initial level

params.name: high
params.label: Upper barrier, % of the initial level

script:
# Daily closes, six months.

2027-01-04
    low = 0.85
    high = 1.15
    payout = 100
    s0 = spot()
    inside = 1

schedule(2027-01-05, 2027-06-30, 1D, US, F)
    if spot() <= low * s0 or spot() >= high * s0 then inside = 0 endIf

2027-07-06
    if spot() <= low * s0 or spot() >= high * s0 then inside = 0 endIf
    if inside = 1 then pays payout endIf

title: Down-and-in put
sources: Rubinstein & Reiner, Breaking Down the Barriers, Risk, 1991
Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: A put that only comes to life if the stock closes at or below the barrier at some point.

params.name: barrier
params.label: Knock-in barrier, % of the initial level

script:
# Daily closes. The building block of every barrier reverse convertible.

2027-01-04
    strike = 1.0
    barrier = 0.7
    s0 = spot()
    ki = 0

schedule(2027-01-05, 2027-12-30, 1D, US, F)
    if spot() <= barrier * s0 then ki = 1 endIf

2028-01-04
    if spot() <= barrier * s0 then ki = 1 endIf
    if ki = 1 then pays max(strike * s0 - spot(), 0) endIf

title: European call
sources: Black & Scholes, The Pricing of Options and Corporate Liabilities, Journal of Political Economy, 1973
Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: The right to buy the stock at its strike level one year later: pays the rise of the stock over the strike, nothing if it ends below.
script:
# Paid in the stock's currency, per share.

2027-01-04
    strike = 1.0
    s0 = spot()

2028-01-04
    pays max(spot() - strike * s0, 0)

title: Everest
sources: Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: A long capital-protected note paying a yearly coupon and, at maturity, the rise of the worst of three stocks.
script:
# Three years. Coupons are guaranteed; the capital is protected, and the
# worst performance is paid if positive.

2027-01-04
    notional = 1000
    coupon = 0.02
    s0 = spot(0)
    s1 = spot(1)
    s2 = spot(2)

2028-01-04  2029-01-04
    pays notional * coupon

2030-01-04
    worst = min(spot(0) / s0, min(spot(1) / s1, spot(2) / s2))
    pays notional * (1 + coupon + max(worst - 1, 0))

title: Fixed-strike lookback call
sources: Goldman, Sosin & Gatto, Path Dependent Options: Buy at the Low, Sell at the High, Journal of Finance, 1979
Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: A call on the highest weekly close of the year rather than the final one.
script:
2027-01-04
    strike = 1.0
    s0 = spot()
    hi = spot()

schedule(2027-01-11, 2027-12-27, 1W, US, F)
    hi = max(hi, spot())

2028-01-04
    hi = max(hi, spot())
    pays max(hi - strike * s0, 0)

title: Floating-strike lookback call
sources: Goldman, Sosin & Gatto, Path Dependent Options: Buy at the Low, Sell at the High, Journal of Finance, 1979
Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: Buy at the lowest close of the year: pays the final price minus the minimum close.
script:
# The minimum is taken over every daily close from the strike date on.

2027-01-04
    lo = spot()

schedule(2027-01-05, 2027-12-30, 1D, US, F)
    lo = min(lo, spot())

2028-01-04
    lo = min(lo, spot())
    pays spot() - lo

title: Forward-start call
sources: Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: A call whose strike is set three months from now, at a percentage of the spot on that date: the price of future volatility, not of today's moneyness.

params.name: strike
params.label: Strike, % of the spot on the strike date

script:
# The strike is fixed on 2027-04-05; the option matures on 2028-01-04.
# Its value depends on the forward smile.

2027-04-05
    strike = 1.0
    k = strike * spot()

2028-01-04
    pays max(spot() - k, 0)

title: Globally floored cliquet
sources: Wilmott, Cliquet Options and Volatility Models, Wilmott Magazine, 2002
Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: Twelve monthly returns, each clipped to a range, summed, with a guaranteed minimum on the total.
script:
# The global floor is what makes it sensitive to the forward smile.

2027-01-04
    notional = 1000
    local_floor = -0.03
    local_cap = 0.03
    global_floor = 0.02
    ref = spot()
    total = 0

schedule(2027-02-04, 2027-12-04, 1M, US, F)
    total = total + min(max(spot() / ref - 1, local_floor), local_cap)
    ref = spot()

2028-01-04
    total = total + min(max(spot() / ref - 1, local_floor), local_cap)
    pays notional * max(total, global_floor)

title: Himalaya
sources: Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: Each year the best performer of the remaining stocks is locked in and removed; pays the average of the locked performances above the strike.

params.name: strike
params.label: Strike on the average locked performance

script:
# Three stocks, three yearly observations. A removed stock gets a
# performance of -1000 so it can never be the best again.

2027-01-04
    notional = 1000
    strike = 1.0
    s0 = spot(0)
    s1 = spot(1)
    s2 = spot(2)
    in0 = 1
    in1 = 1
    in2 = 1
    total = 0

2028-01-04  2029-01-04  2030-01-04
    q0 = in0 * spot(0) / s0 - (1 - in0) * 1000
    q1 = in1 * spot(1) / s1 - (1 - in1) * 1000
    q2 = in2 * spot(2) / s2 - (1 - in2) * 1000
    best = max(q0, max(q1, q2))
    total = total + best
    if q0 = best then
        in0 = 0
    else
        if q1 = best then in1 = 0 else in2 = 0 endIf
    endIf

2030-01-07
    pays notional * max(total / 3 - strike, 0)

title: Ladder call
sources: Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: An at-the-money call that locks in gains: once the stock closes above a rung, at least that rung is paid.

params.name: step
params.label: Gap between rungs, % of the initial level

script:
# Three rungs above the initial level, daily closes. Pays the larger of the
# final call and the highest rung reached.

2027-01-04
    step = 0.1
    s0 = spot()
    rung = 1

schedule(2027-01-05, 2027-12-30, 1D, US, F)
    if spot() >= (1 + step) * s0 then rung = max(rung, 1 + step) endIf
    if spot() >= (1 + 2 * step) * s0 then rung = max(rung, 1 + 2 * step) endIf
    if spot() >= (1 + 3 * step) * s0 then rung = max(rung, 1 + 3 * step) endIf

2028-01-04
    pays max(max(spot() - s0, 0), (rung - 1) * s0)

title: Napoleon
sources: Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: Each year pays a fixed coupon plus the worst monthly return of that year, floored at zero; capital back after two years.

params.name: coupon
params.label: Fixed part of the yearly coupon

script:
# Each year's coupon is paid on its anniversary; the capital is repaid with
# the last one.

2027-01-04
    notional = 1000
    coupon = 0.08
    ref = spot()
    worst = 1

schedule(2027-02-04, 2027-12-04, 1M, US, F)
    worst = min(worst, spot() / ref - 1)
    ref = spot()

2028-01-04
    worst = min(worst, spot() / ref - 1)
    ref = spot()
    pays notional * max(coupon + worst, 0)
    worst = 1

schedule(2028-02-04, 2028-12-04, 1M, US, F)
    worst = min(worst, spot() / ref - 1)
    ref = spot()

2029-01-04
    worst = min(worst, spot() / ref - 1)
    pays notional * (1 + max(coupon + worst, 0))

title: One-touch (down)
sources: Reiner & Rubinstein, Unscrambling the Binary Code, Risk, 1991
Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: Pays a fixed amount at maturity if the stock closes at or below the touch level at least once.

params.name: level
params.label: Touch level, % of the initial level

script:
# Daily closes; paid at maturity, not when touched.

2027-01-04
    level = 0.8
    payout = 100
    s0 = spot()
    touched = 0

schedule(2027-01-05, 2027-12-30, 1D, US, F)
    if spot() <= level * s0 then touched = 1 endIf

2028-01-04
    if spot() <= level * s0 then touched = 1 endIf
    if touched = 1 then pays payout endIf

title: Outperformance option
sources: Margrabe, The Value of an Option to Exchange One Asset for Another, Journal of Finance, 1978
Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: Pays how much the first stock outperformed the second over the year, if it did.
script:
# spot(0) is the stock expected to outperform, spot(1) the benchmark. Its
# value rises as their correlation falls.

2027-01-04
    notional = 1000
    spread = 0.0
    s0 = spot(0)
    s1 = spot(1)

2028-01-04
    pays notional * max(spot(0) / s0 - spot(1) / s1 - spread, 0)

title: Phoenix autocall with memory
sources: Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: Semi-annual coupons paid when the stock is above the coupon barrier, with missed coupons caught up; redeemed early above the autocall level; capital at risk below the protection barrier at maturity.

params.name: autocall
params.label: Autocall level, % of the initial level

params.name: coupon_barrier
params.label: Coupon barrier, % of the initial level

params.name: protection
params.label: Protection barrier at maturity, % of the initial level

script:
# Below the protection barrier at maturity the capital is repaid in
# proportion to the fall (European knock-in).

2027-01-04
    notional = 1000
    coupon = 0.05
    autocall = 1.0
    coupon_barrier = 0.7
    protection = 0.6
    s0 = spot()
    miss = 0
    alive = 1

2027-07-06  2028-01-04  2028-07-06
    if alive = 1 then
        if spot() >= autocall * s0 then
            pays notional * (1 + coupon * (miss + 1))
            alive = 0
        else
            if spot() >= coupon_barrier * s0 then
                pays notional * coupon * (miss + 1)
                miss = 0
            else
                miss = miss + 1
            endIf
        endIf
    endIf

2029-01-04
    if alive = 1 then
        if spot() >= coupon_barrier * s0 then
            pays notional * (1 + coupon * (miss + 1))
        else
            if spot() < protection * s0 then
                pays notional * spot() / s0
            else
                pays notional
            endIf
        endIf
    endIf

title: Rainbow call
sources: Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: A call on a basket whose weights go by rank: the largest weight on the best performer, the smallest on the worst.
script:
# With three stocks the middle performer is the sum minus the best and the
# worst.

2027-01-04
    notional = 1000
    w_best = 0.5
    w_middle = 0.3
    w_worst = 0.2
    s0 = spot(0)
    s1 = spot(1)
    s2 = spot(2)

2028-01-04
    p0 = spot(0) / s0
    p1 = spot(1) / s1
    p2 = spot(2) / s2
    best = max(p0, max(p1, p2))
    worst = min(p0, min(p1, p2))
    middle = p0 + p1 + p2 - best - worst
    pays notional * max(w_best * best + w_middle * middle + w_worst * worst - 1, 0)

title: Range accrual note
sources: Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: Earns a coupon on each day the stock closes inside a range around its initial level; capital protected.

params.name: coupon
params.label: Coupon per year if every day is in range

params.name: low
params.label: Lower bound, % of the initial level

params.name: high
params.label: Upper bound, % of the initial level

script:
# Coupon at maturity = coupon x (days in range / days observed).

2027-01-04
    notional = 1000
    coupon = 0.08
    low = 0.9
    high = 1.1
    s0 = spot()
    inside = 0
    n = 0

schedule(2027-01-05, 2027-12-30, 1D, US, F)
    n = n + 1
    if spot() >= low * s0 and spot() <= high * s0 then inside = inside + 1 endIf

2028-01-04
    n = n + 1
    if spot() >= low * s0 and spot() <= high * s0 then inside = inside + 1 endIf
    pays notional * (1 + coupon * inside / n)

title: Reverse cliquet
sources: Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: A large coupon from which every negative monthly return is subtracted, floored at zero: the investor sells downside volatility.
script:
# Capital protected. Coupon at maturity: max(coupon + sum of the negative
# monthly returns, 0).

2027-01-04
    notional = 1000
    coupon = 0.4
    ref = spot()
    losses = 0

schedule(2027-02-04, 2027-12-04, 1M, US, F)
    losses = losses + min(spot() / ref - 1, 0)
    ref = spot()

2028-01-04
    losses = losses + min(spot() / ref - 1, 0)
    pays notional * (1 + max(coupon + losses, 0))

title: Reverse convertible
sources: Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: A one-year note paying a high coupon; the capital comes back in full only if the stock ends at or above the strike, otherwise in proportion to its fall.
script:
# The investor is short a put: that premium pays for the coupon.

2027-01-04
    notional = 1000
    coupon = 0.1
    strike = 1.0
    s0 = spot()

2028-01-04
    pays notional * coupon
    if spot() >= strike * s0 then pays notional else pays notional * spot() / (strike * s0) endIf

title: Shark fin note
sources: Rubinstein & Reiner, Breaking Down the Barriers, Risk, 1991
Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: A capital-protected note paying the stock's rise, unless the stock ever closes at or above the barrier: then only a rebate on top of the capital.

params.name: barrier
params.label: Knock-out barrier, % of the initial level

params.name: rebate
params.label: Rebate if knocked out, % of notional

script:
# Capital protected at maturity; daily closes. Its payoff chart looks like a
# shark's fin: rising, then a cliff.

2027-01-04
    notional = 1000
    participation = 1.0
    barrier = 1.25
    rebate = 0.05
    s0 = spot()
    alive = 1

schedule(2027-01-05, 2027-12-30, 1D, US, F)
    if spot() >= barrier * s0 then alive = 0 endIf

2028-01-04
    if spot() >= barrier * s0 then alive = 0 endIf
    if alive = 1 then
        pays notional * (1 + participation * max(spot() / s0 - 1, 0))
    else
        pays notional * (1 + rebate)
    endIf

title: Twin-win certificate
sources: Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: Gains whichever way the stock moves, as long as it never closes at or below the barrier.
script:
# Above the barrier the investor earns the absolute performance; once
# touched, plain stock.

2027-01-04
    notional = 1000
    barrier = 0.7
    s0 = spot()
    hit = 0

schedule(2027-01-05, 2027-12-30, 1D, US, F)
    if spot() <= barrier * s0 then hit = 1 endIf

2028-01-04
    if spot() <= barrier * s0 then hit = 1 endIf
    if hit = 0 then
        pays notional * (1 + abs(spot() / s0 - 1))
    else
        pays notional * spot() / s0
    endIf

title: Up-and-out call
sources: Rubinstein & Reiner, Breaking Down the Barriers, Risk, 1991
Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: A call that dies if the stock ever closes at or above the barrier.

params.name: barrier
params.label: Knock-out barrier, % of the initial level

script:
# Barrier checked at every close (a daily grid approximates continuous
# monitoring). No rebate.

2027-01-04
    strike = 1.0
    barrier = 1.3
    s0 = spot()
    alive = 1

schedule(2027-01-05, 2027-12-30, 1D, US, F)
    if spot() >= barrier * s0 then alive = 0 endIf

2028-01-04
    if spot() >= barrier * s0 then alive = 0 endIf
    if alive = 1 then pays max(spot() - strike * s0, 0) endIf

title: Variance swap
sources: Demeterfi, Derman, Kamal & Zou, A Guide to Volatility and Variance Swaps, Journal of Derivatives, 1999
Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: Exchanges the realised variance of daily returns over a year for a fixed volatility strike squared.
script:
# Realised variance = 252 / n x sum of squared daily log returns (zero mean).

2027-01-04
    variance_notional = 10000
    vol_strike = 0.2
    prev = spot()
    sumsq = 0
    n = 0

schedule(2027-01-05, 2027-12-30, 1D, US, F)
    sumsq = sumsq + log(spot() / prev) ^ 2
    n = n + 1
    prev = spot()

2028-01-04
    sumsq = sumsq + log(spot() / prev) ^ 2
    n = n + 1
    pays variance_notional * (252 * sumsq / n - vol_strike ^ 2)

title: Volatility swap
sources: Demeterfi, Derman, Kamal & Zou, A Guide to Volatility and Variance Swaps, Journal of Derivatives, 1999
Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: Exchanges realised volatility (not variance) for a fixed strike.
script:
# Realised volatility = sqrt(252 / n x sum of squared daily log returns).

2027-01-04
    vega_notional = 1000
    vol_strike = 0.2
    prev = spot()
    sumsq = 0
    n = 0

schedule(2027-01-05, 2027-12-30, 1D, US, F)
    sumsq = sumsq + log(spot() / prev) ^ 2
    n = n + 1
    prev = spot()

2028-01-04
    sumsq = sumsq + log(spot() / prev) ^ 2
    n = n + 1
    pays 100 * vega_notional * (sqrt(252 * sumsq / n) - vol_strike)

title: Worst-of Phoenix autocall
sources: Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: The most traded structured product: quarterly coupons while the worst of three stocks is above the coupon barrier, early redemption above the autocall level, capital at risk below the protection barrier at maturity.
script:
# Two years, quarterly observations on the worst performer, no coupon
# memory.

2027-01-04
    notional = 1000
    coupon = 0.025
    autocall = 1.0
    coupon_barrier = 0.7
    protection = 0.6
    s0 = spot(0)
    s1 = spot(1)
    s2 = spot(2)
    alive = 1

schedule(2027-04-05, 2028-10-04, 3M, US, F)
    worst = min(spot(0) / s0, min(spot(1) / s1, spot(2) / s2))
    if alive = 1 then
        if worst >= autocall then
            pays notional * (1 + coupon)
            alive = 0
        else
            if worst >= coupon_barrier then pays notional * coupon endIf
        endIf
    endIf

2029-01-04
    worst = min(spot(0) / s0, min(spot(1) / s1, spot(2) / s2))
    if alive = 1 then
        if worst >= coupon_barrier then
            pays notional * (1 + coupon)
        else
            if worst < protection then pays notional * worst else pays notional endIf
        endIf
    endIf

title: Worst-of call
sources: Stulz, Options on the Minimum or the Maximum of Two Risky Assets, Journal of Financial Economics, 1982
Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: A call on the worst performer of three stocks: it pays only if all three rose, so it is cheap and long correlation.
script:
2027-01-04
    notional = 1000
    strike = 1.0
    s0 = spot(0)
    s1 = spot(1)
    s2 = spot(2)

2028-01-04
    worst = min(spot(0) / s0, min(spot(1) / s1, spot(2) / s2))
    pays notional * max(worst - strike, 0)

title: Worst-of barrier reverse convertible
sources: Bouzoubaa & Osseiran, Exotic Options and Hybrids: A Guide to Structuring, Pricing and Trading, Wiley, 2010
summary: Quarterly coupons on three stocks; the capital is at risk if the worst of them ever closes at or below the barrier and ends below its initial level.

params.name: barrier
params.label: Knock-in barrier on the worst, % of initial

script:
# Knock-in on the worst performer, daily closes. The higher coupon than a
# single-stock version pays for the short correlation.

2027-01-04
    notional = 1000
    coupon = 0.03
    barrier = 0.6
    s0 = spot(0)
    s1 = spot(1)
    s2 = spot(2)
    ki = 0

schedule(2027-01-05, 2027-12-30, 1D, US, F)
    worst = min(spot(0) / s0, min(spot(1) / s1, spot(2) / s2))
    if worst <= barrier then ki = 1 endIf

2027-04-05  2027-07-06  2027-10-04
    pays notional * coupon

2028-01-04
    worst = min(spot(0) / s0, min(spot(1) / s1, spot(2) / s2))
    if worst <= barrier then ki = 1 endIf
    pays notional * coupon
    if ki = 1 and worst < 1 then pays notional * worst else pays notional endIf
